rules.statement: In an action for a declaration of a right of way over several contiguous lands, it is necessary to join the owners of all servient tenements over which the right of way is claimed.
rules.supporting_quote: Where an action is brought to" vindicate a right of way over several contiguous lands it is necessary to join the owners of all the servient tenements over which the right of way is claimed.

meta.parties: Fernando Et Al. v. Dona Maria Et Al
